## Disposition

Accept six scoped propositions and elementary consequences of the credited Ang–Remy–Sun annulus theorem. The full two-loop embedded-pair Radon–Nikodym/lattice comparison remains unresolved after 5/5 substantive approaches. No sixth approach, full solution, novelty certification or exhaustive prior-resolution claim.

The finite model retains positive fugacities and vertex-disjoint cycles. Palm disintegration explicitly requires standard Borel spaces and sigma-finite intensity; almost-sure local finiteness alone does not suffice. Pairs are ordered, distinct and from the same realization. The CLE resolvent is restricted to origin-surrounding outer-to-inner descendants. Modulus marginals alone do not determine the conditional embedded-shape law. ARS lambda/modulus/generation/sine/kappa=4 constants remain explicit. The Ising citation is square-grid/Jordan-domain/+ boundary and model-metric specific. The UI counterexample has almost-sure eventual matching by Borel–Cantelli.

## Corrected mathematics and fresh verification

The corrected report, full authored audit, correction note, authored patch, safe checkers and public source metadata are exact copies of the accepted derivative. Full old report, old harnesses/logs, copied source PDF/text, datasets, private sources/coordination and identifying metadata are excluded. Earlier acceptance and retrieval/inspection history are labeled historical.

Per mode, the independent suite supports 42,097 exact mathematical checks on 82 graph inputs, separately from 297 diagnostics at 70 decimal digits and one environment check. The original safe checker adds 1,482 graph identities, 6 symbolic identities and 60 rare-event identities. Nineteen semantic mutants fail at their intended conditions, including three numerical-formula diagnostic mutations. One forced exception is checked separately and is not counted as a semantic mutation.

Normal, -O and -OO final fixed-bootstrap runs use actual UID=EUID=1000, files 0444 and directory 0555. Full stdout/stderr are pinned and compared exactly with recursive JSON type checks and no normalization. Physical create/append probes, complete before/after hashes, integrity/schema/comparator negatives and hostile full-baseline equality passed.

Each mode recorded 51 whole-delivery EACCES denials, 4 mathematical-fixture denials and 44 child denials; 67 integrity negatives, 75 schema/scope negatives and 41 comparator negatives.

CPython 3.12.14, SymPy 1.14.0 and mpmath 1.3.0 are installed trusted dependencies. Their implementation bytes are not authenticated by this packet. The isolated no-site adapter adds only the installed purelib directory without processing .pth/startup hooks; version checks and hostile local sympy/mpmath import tests passed. This is not hermetic dependency verification or a formal proof of continuum theorems.

Pre-seal receipts are clearly labeled and bound by the final manifest. Final external receipts are outside the inventory to avoid circular self-hashing. NOT_RUN: historical audit-harness replay, historical patch application, full old-report replay, source-body replay, new source search, dataset replay and formal proof-assistant verification.
